Massachusetts

5 directory entries · Research in progress

  • Abenaki↗Historical ancestral territory connection
    Connection & source
    Historical ancestral territory connection

    Nation history explicitly includes part of Massachusetts in Ndakina. Historical territory does not authenticate present state-recognized identity claims; no whole-state polygon inferred.

    Before European colonization; continuing homeland relationship. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Massachusett↗Historical homeland described by a continuing community
    Connection & source
    Historical homeland described by a continuing community

    The community’s history explicitly places Indigenous Massachusett villages in what is now the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, describing a coastal and inland range using Salem, Plymouth and Worcester. This directly supports a Massachusetts historical connection. Inspection: Actual opening geographic and community paragraphs, HTML lines 55–57, inspected. Limits: The Neponset/Ponkapoag community account is attributed to its publisher, not treated as the only Massachusett perspective. No state/federal recognition determination, epidemic percentage or exact historical boundary is adopted.

    Before and during early European colonial arrival. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Nauset↗Historical people connection
    Connection & source
    Historical people connection

    Eastham's public-history page explicitly locates the historical Nauset people on Cape Cod in Massachusetts and identifies their principal village near present Eastham. This supports a historical Massachusetts route, rather than a connection inferred from Nauset place names alone. Inspection: Read all five substantive paragraphs. The opening geographic statement and village-location paragraph establish this finding aid. Limits: The page uses dated outsider terminology and old population/disappearance claims; none is adopted. The Nauset access point is retained with historical scope. This does not settle their political relationship to Wampanoag communities or identify a present government. The NPS whaling report was read selectively for context but is not the basis of this association; its broad Wampanoag framing does not resolve every Nauset naming question.

    Colonial-era Nauset communities on Cape Cod; undated historical text hosted by the Town of Eastham. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Nipmuc↗Community published historical homeland connection
    Connection & source
    Community published historical homeland connection

    The Hassanamisco Nipmuc account explicitly identifies central Massachusetts among Nipmuc homelands. This is one community's published history, without equating every Nipmuc community with its government.

    Public content inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Wampanoag↗Historical and continuing community connection
    Connection & source
    Historical and continuing community connection

    Aquinnah government's public introduction identifies Martha's Vineyard; broader history explicitly names southeastern Massachusetts.

    Historical and continuing; inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
